new_metric_inserted: projected LLM input-token and model-call reduction only

updates.after: Benchmarked the structured deterministic path against a documented full-context LLM baseline on 160 synthetic ordering conversations (868 turns): the offline path retained AUTO_DRAFT, CONFIRM, HANDOFF, and REFUSE gates while reducing projected LLM input-token transfer and model-call requirements by 100% (bootstrap 95% CI, 100%–100%); counts use a deterministic Unicode-codepoint estimator and do not represent billed tokens.
updates.before: Structured routine ordering operations around canonical intents, deterministic state transitions, and explicit safety rules, while confining optional model-driven reasoning to a validated fallback sandbox for low-confidence cases; designed the architecture to limit unnecessary model calls and long-context transmission and make latency, inference cost, and high-impact actions more controllable, with AUTO_DRAFT, CONFIRM, HANDOFF, and REFUSE pathways.

updates.after: 在 160 组合成订餐会话（868 轮）上成对比较结构化路径与有文档定义的完整上下文 LLM 基线：禁用实时 LLM 的离线配置在保留 AUTO_DRAFT、CONFIRM、HANDOFF、REFUSE 门控下，使预估 LLM 输入 Token 传输量和模型调用需求均降低 100%（Bootstrap 95% CI：100%–100%；Unicode code-point 估算，非实际计费 Token）。
updates.before: 以规范化意图、确定性状态转换和显式安全规则处理常规订餐操作，仅在经校验的低置信度 fallback 沙箱中保留可选模型推理；该设计旨在减少不必要的模型调用与长上下文传输，使延迟、推理成本和高影响操作更可控，并设置 AUTO_DRAFT、CONFIRM、HANDOFF、REFUSE 四类路径。
